messages.author: Kwame Asante
messages.text: Google Android attribution is back. The re-linked integration went live late on Aug 9, and Aug 10 shows 4,490 Google Android installs (CPI $1.33) and Organic Android back to ~4.1k. Affected window is Aug 6 to Aug 9, four full days.

replies.author: Daniel Esposito
replies.text: Confirmed in the network UI. Phew :sweat_smile:

replies.author: Ingrid Solberg
replies.text: Total misattributed: about 17k Google Android installs counted as Organic (Organic Android was ~35k over the 4 days vs ~16.5k normal). I'll annotate the dashboard and the weekly report.

replies.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
replies.text: Thanks. Can Attributa restate the four days?

replies.author: Kwame Asante
replies.text: Asked. They say no: postbacks that failed during the window can't be re-attributed. Our tables will keep showing those installs as Organic. Post-mortem doc to follow.
